messages:
Kai Nakamura: Hey everyone! I'm Kai — starting today as a Data Infra Engineer. Super excited to be here. Quick questions: where do I pick up my badge and what are the best nearby ramen spots? Also bringing a tiny monstera for my desk :seedling: 

Jordana Li: Welcome Kai!! Badge pickup is at the security desk on 2F, bring a photo ID. They usually run a quick form. Hours 9am-5pm. :wave:

onboarding-bot: Hi Kai — welcome to Redwood Inference! Your onboarding checklist: 1) HR paperwork (sent to your email) 2) Badge pickup at security desk 3) Laptop/monitor pickup from IT (Rm 108) 4) Join #new-hires and #random :white_check_mark:

Alex Wu: hey Kai — welcome! ramen recs: Tonkotsu on 5th (rich tonkotsu) and Ichiban across the square (shoyu is great). A few of us are grabbing ramen tomorrow at 12:00 if you want to join :ramen:

Maya Chen: welcome!! love the monstera :) we do a tiny plant swap on Wednesdays in the lounge if you want to join. FYI Desk 3B gets good light if you want a sunny spot. Ping me for a spare monitor.

Trevor Kim: Welcome aboard. Quick tip: bike storage is through the east loading door, and there's a discounted monthly pass for the garage (ask finance). Also I'll drop a calendar invite for the ramen lunch — feel free to accept.

Kai Nakamura: Thanks everyone! @Jordana — is passport OR driver's license fine? Also I'll take you up on the ramen tomorrow @Alex :) and I'll swing by security now.

Jordana Li: Either passport or driver's license is fine. If you're on a visa bring that + passport. See you around! :smile:

Alex Wu: great, see you tomorrow noon at Tonkotsu (meet at lobby). Adding a note: cash/card both accepted, but peak lunch lines — we'll try to get a table.

Kai Nakamura: Perfect — thanks for the warm welcome. Looking forward to meeting folks in person! :grinning:
